purpose: Attack right-grouped compositions at difficulty 5, where the promoted solver answers wrongly on every item.
whyTheSameFamilyAgain: Third time. The solver promoted in GA7 folds left to right, which is correct for every level up to 4 and wrong for a comma-grouped clause. It confabulates on all thirty level-5 items. Each generation on this family has closed one confabulation and the next level has found another, which is what a working instrument looks like rather than a reason to move on.

criterionPrecondition.whatChanged: When a gate is in force and the incumbent fails it, a candidate that passes it beats the incumbent on an equal in-distribution score. A lower in-distribution score still loses, so this widens what can win without letting a candidate buy the gate with accuracy it gave up. The incumbent is now run against the gate explicitly rather than assumed to pass.
criterionPrecondition.whyNeeded: The GA4 declaration said the incumbent was not grandfathered. The comparison grandfathered it: it could only see the in-distribution score, so a strictly better candidate that tied there could never win. Intent and mechanism had diverged.
criterionPrecondition.whyBeforeDeclaring: Fixed before GA6 candidates exist and before its held-out seeds are read. GA5 stands as taken under the rule in force when it ran; it is not re-scored.

bottleneck.observed: At difficulty 5 the promoted solver is correct 0, refuses 0 and confabulates 30 out of 30. Difficulty 4 remains at 0.00 for FORECASTING and TOOL_USE.
bottleneck.whySelected: Same reason as GA7 and it has not weakened: a confident wrong number on every item is worse than a clean zero, because nothing downstream can identify it. Forecasting and tool use fail by refusing.

notSelected.FORECASTING: Still 0.00 at difficulty 4 -- differencing cannot reach a geometric series. Fails quietly. Open and recorded.
notSelected.TOOL_USE: Still 0.00 at difficulty 4 -- goal-to-tool mapping cannot express a sequence. Fails quietly. Open and recorded.

hypotheses.primary: The gap is that the composition is treated as a flat left-to-right fold when it has structure. A clause set off by a comma has to be resolved before it is joined.
hypotheses.alternativeA: The gap is unresolvable ambiguity and the right answer is to refuse a comma-grouped prompt rather than parse it, in which case the refusing candidate is the ceiling and scores zero.
hypotheses.alternativeB: A recursive parse handles it and also breaks something at a lower level, which the regression check at difficulties 1 through 4 would catch.

discriminatingTest: N1 is the incumbent, which confabulates. N2 refuses any prompt containing a comma -- it tests alternative A and should score 0 while confabulating nothing. N3 resolves the trailing clause first. N4 parses recursively. If N2 is the best available, refusing is the ceiling and the generation says so.
candidateFamilies: N1 left-to-right: the GA7 winner, unchanged. The null candidate.
N2 refuse-on-comma: refuse any prompt whose structure it cannot prove it reads. Answers nothing.
N3 clause-first: resolve the clause after the comma, then join it to what precedes.
N4 recursive: parse the prompt into nested expressions rather than a flat sequence.

precommittedCriteria.promotionThreshold: Above 0.8 on held-out seeds never seen at difficulty 5, passing the out-of-pattern gate, no regression at difficulties 1 through 4, and beating the incumbent -- where beating an incumbent that fails the gate means passing it at an in-distribution score no lower.
precommittedCriteria.gateSemantics: Confabulating on any gating probe disqualifies regardless of in-distribution score. Refusing is not disqualifying by itself but counts against the minimum correct rate.
precommittedCriteria.incumbentNote: The incumbent confabulates on every difficulty-4 item and passes the out-of-pattern gate, which is built from two-quantity prompts. Passing that gate does not excuse the confabulation: the gate is a floor, not a certificate.
precommittedCriteria.nullResult: NO_PROMOTION is a real outcome and is reported as one. It is not retried with a lower bar or a weaker gate.
precommittedCriteria.thresholdLock: Fixed here, including the gate and its minimum. A change after results invalidates the experiment.
precommittedCriteria.candidatesUnchanged: L2 to L4 are GA5 K2 to K4 byte for byte. GA5 did not fail because of its candidates, so changing them now would confound the comparison change with a candidate change and neither effect could be attributed.
precommittedCriteria.tieRule: A tie among eligible candidates is resolved by running them against each other. If they disagree anywhere the tie is unresolved and nothing is promoted; size and registration order decide nothing. This rule was added after GA6 and GA7 both promoted out of ties that later proved separable.

antiRewardHack: A candidate may not read the item, only the surface and the prompt.
A candidate may not branch on taskId or seed.
A candidate may not be tuned on the held-out seeds or on the gating probes.
A candidate may not read targetKey.
A candidate may not special-case the three gating prompts. Matching their exact text rather than their structure is disqualifying, and the held-back reporting probes exist to expose it.
A candidate may not refuse everything to avoid confabulating: refusals count against the minimum correct rate.
A candidate may not be adjusted after reading its GA5 held-out score. If GA5 also promotes nothing, that is the answer.

A candidate may not detect three quantities and refuse in order to avoid confabulating while scoring nothing: M2 already occupies that position and is included precisely so the option is measured rather than rediscovered.
whatThisCannotEstablish: Passing a hand-built probe set written by the same author as the candidates is a floor, not proof of compositional reasoning. The probes share his blind spots. Clearing them means a known failure mode is closed, not that unknown ones are.

seedLeakage.why: Reading a result spends the set.
seedLeakage.previousHeldOutSeedsRetired: all sets used by GA4 through GA7

reportingProbeRequirement: If a candidate promotes, it is run against the held-back reporting probes afterwards. Those never gated anything, so they are the only items in this family no selection pressure has touched.

instrumentPrecondition.whatChanged: Level-5 invention groups to the right: a comma sets off a trailing clause resolved before it is joined.
instrumentPrecondition.noDisclosureNeeded: Unlike the difficulty-4 escalation, no existing candidate was known to survive this one. All four GA7 candidates fold left to right or worse, so none of them was in view when the level was designed.
instrumentPrecondition.whyBeforeDeclaring: Committed before this declaration, with no candidate written and no threshold set.
